statements.t: • The company increased its projected savings under Project Elevate to $1 billion, up from its prior $500 million estimate, following a comprehensive portfolio review and identification of additional operational efficiencies.
• The company expects to repurchase $500 million of its common stock during the fourth quarter of 2026 under its existing share repurchase authorization.
“Our second-half initiatives are on track to support the revenue acceleration we expect in the fourth quarter, and we are reaffirming our full-year guidance.
Our growing confidence also allows us to resume share repurchases earlier than anticipated, with $500 million planned in the fourth quarter.”
